description: This file contains unit tests for the SystemHandler class in a Kotlin-based project, specifically testing the handling of system notifications including authorization, validation, and posting behavior.

classes.name: SystemHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the SystemHandler responsible for processing system notifications.

classes.name: FakePoster
classes.description: A mock implementation of SystemNotificationPoster used for testing, simulating a system that posts notifications.

classes.name: ThrowingPoster
classes.description: A mock implementation of SystemNotificationPoster that throws exceptions to test error handling.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsUnauthorized
methods.description: Tests that the notification handler rejects unauthorized requests.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsEmptyNotification
methods.description: Tests that empty notification content is rejected.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsInvalidRequestObject
methods.description: Tests that incomplete JSON objects are rejected.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_postsNotification
methods.description: Tests successful posting of a valid notification.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_trimsAndPassesOptionalFields
methods.description: Ensures optional fields are trimmed and passed correctly.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_returnsUnauthorizedWhenPostFailsPermission
methods.description: Checks that a permission error results in an unauthorized response.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_returnsUnavailableWhenPostFailsUnexpectedly
methods.description: Checks that unexpected errors during posting result in an unavailable response.
